summary: Sprott Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated August 4, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors declared a second quarter 2026 dividend of US$0.40 per common share. The dividend is payable on September 1, 2026, to shareholders of record on August 17, 2026. Canadian-resident shareholders will receive payment in Canadian dollars at the spot exchange rate on the payment date, while others receive U.S. dollars. The dividend is designated as an eligible dividend for Canadian tax purposes. This is a routine quarterly capital return to shareholders with no strategic or structural special-situation elements, and no advisors or deal mechanics are involved.
